comment: Development default, compiled into debug builds of the shell only (release builds, i.e. the installer's, have none; used when neither OMNIAPI_SHELL_CONFIG nor a shell.config.json next to the exe exists). Runs the service from the checkout the shell was built from, with that checkout's mcp/.venv, on the real port 7788 -- a shell started with this default adopts the service already running there, and its Quit stops it. Tests must point OMNIAPI_SHELL_CONFIG at their own config.
